title: INNOVATIVE ONE PIECE AI GAME DESIGN
author: Traditional_One_2819
selftext: I am serching for People to help me design my ai based one piece open world game. I have some ideas that could change gaming sector forever so if u ar in with me hit me up

comments.author: pianoboy777
comments.body: Are you paying people to help you ?

replies.author: Traditional_One_2819
replies.body: Im looking for someone invested in my idea that could help me develop something truly unique. I will be ho est, i  am not willimg to pay for the help. More like sharing ideas and team up, mostly because the game i am thinking is not an easy task.

replies.author: Big_Presentation2786
replies.body:
Not an easy task?


Ok.. I'm interested- I'm an experienced coder with a shit ton of history in gaming.


What sort of coin are looking to exchange?

replies.author: Big_Presentation2786
replies.body: You lost me at 'I am not willing..'

comments.author: pianoboy777
comments.body: So you want people to help you with a task you said yourself isn’t easy lol and you don’t want to pay ??

replies.author: Traditional_One_2819
replies.body: I know this sound crazy. But im not asking for a full game help or anything impossibile. Just a hint of it. Than we can sell it to big companies. Ultimately I'm looking for someone who will listen to my ideas and if they see potential they can help me.

replies.author: preytowolves
replies.body: got a big ol belly laugh, thanks.

replies.author: TwistedSpiral
replies.body: I'm gonna tell you right now. There's not a single game company on earth who will listen to ideas from some random and make a game out of it. Ideas are the easiest part of game design by far. Every game dev has 50 of them they'd like love their company to commit to making.

comments.author: Big_Presentation2786
comments.body:
I think you've got something here bro..


There's potential..
Not a lot of potential as you've mentioned you're not willing to pay..


But I think... If you get 12 jobs..
You might just crack it..

replies.author: Traditional_One_2819
replies.body: I know it will be rough. Btw thanks for not sharing hate

replies.author: Traditional_One_2819
replies.body: But i can offer only those

replies.author: dog__father
replies.body: you and literally everyone else, unfortunately

replies.author: Traditional_One_2819
replies.body: For me is the first time opening up and looking for help, sorry if im Just like every other idea guy to you guys

replies.author: dog__father
replies.body:
if you’re being genuine - i would consider what other things you can offer (programming, writing, audio, etc), start a project with that, and then take that demo and try to find help. even then it will be rare to find free help unless you start with a team with the same idea. for the exact same reason that you want to work on your idea and not someone else’s :)

if you don’t have those other skills, i would consider learning one of them. the “idea guy” is a meme because everyone in this space has ideas, it’s why we’re here. but implementing an idea take a lot of work and skill. so you generally need to pay for that skill if you don’t have it yourself.

replies.author: Traditional_One_2819
replies.body: Thanks, i will invest my time on it.

comments.author: YouReadMeNow
comments.body:
I know of people working for projects like skyblivion all for free for 10 years,
You can do the same, it all starts with just one person believing in you.

How about this, put as much time into writing the proposal as you wish for people taking you seriously, then you may get somewhere

replies.author: Traditional_One_2819
replies.body: Thanks for getting my moral up bro. But i didnt fully understand you message(im italian so might be a lenguage barrier)
